question: Determine which ordinary and bond readings of two, three or four original same-side marks distinguish a once-loaded ring, at what source offset, layer, reading radius and dose, alone or with a second ring.
public_inputs: Matched even states on padded paths, first-layer feedback as in A113/A114, no new loading or A115 transfer. Complete definition and predictions in definitions.md.
forbidden_inputs: A growing rule that uses scoring marks, original ancestry or the labels; reading incomplete distances as exact; calling an unrestricted ball a bounded local measurement; changing a source or prediction after measurement.
primary_observable: Pair step/route vector, mark-centered knot counts under ordinary and bond radii, and exact minimum joint-bond size or signed bounds with no-bond distinguished.
cheapest_meaningful_control: Far e8/e12 and source equality, pure-path ordinary growth, persistent local saturation criterion, actual parity or connected-shore controls, full four-arm load interaction.
first_executable_signal: Replay e8/e12 on the registered background, then examine higher marked bonds and strict same-side knot counts on the same frozen age and offset panels.
resource_budget: All 792 same-side sets on the original single source where feasible; named translated sets on pads 4,8,16; all 64 fixed-geometry dose assignments; double-ring four-arm contrasts; named physical and solver limits in design.
decision_or_followup_rule: Give a certified same-side witness or a range theorem for the stated reading, compare all five readings, distinguish fixed-radius and unrestricted views and publish any remaining bounds and unresolved all-age cases.
stop_rule: Give a certified same-side witness or a range theorem for the stated reading, compare all five readings, distinguish fixed-radius and unrestricted views and publish any remaining bounds and unresolved all-age cases.
